evidence.text: From the company's own numbers, the FY2026 guide needs a Q4 ramp well above seasonal. H1 revenue is $69.3m (Q1 $36.4m + Q2 $32.9m) and the FY guide is $142-148m, so H2 must be $72.7-78.7m. With Q3 guided flat to slightly above Q2 (about $33-34.5m), Q4 has to be about $38.2-45.7m, which is +11% to +38% sequential. Q4/Q3 was +9% in 2025 ($40.2m to $43.9m) and -2% in 2024 ($35.8m to $35.2m). On that seasonality, a Q3 of about $34m gives a Q4 of $35-37m and a FY of about $139-142m, at or below the low end. So the release (bmo 2026-11-09) carries a material chance of a second cut or a narrowing to the low end. The market's bar is the unchanged $142-148m guide.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last guide cut (2026-08-10, FY $169-174m to $142-148m plus breakeven pushed to 2027) brought -39.95%. 2026-05-06 (Q2 then missed its own guide by about 9%): -16.41%. The 2026-01-08 +23.81% preceded a Q4 2025 beat ($43.9m vs about $38m). The guide line has moved this stock more than anything else.
evidence.why_not_priced: The previews show only a single-quarter revenue consensus ($34.5-37.0m) and the unchanged FY range. evidence.text: The held FY adj. EBITDA guide has almost no slack. YTD adj. EBITDA is Q1 -$5.8m plus Q2 -$3.4m, and with the Q3 guide midpoint of -$4.0m that comes to -$13.2m, already below the FY guide's low end of -$12.5m. Holding the FY range on 9 Nov therefore requires Q4 adj. EBITDA of at least +$0.7m, or +$3.2m to reach the FY midpoint. If Q3 prints at the bottom of its guide (-$4.5m), Q4 must reach +$1.2m. Q3 is also guided as a step back from Q2's -$3.4m, which management put down to seasonality and launch investments (school-year launches). So the line the stock is watching, first-ever positive Q4 EBITDA, rests on a Q4 swing of $4-8m from Q3.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: The FY EBITDA guide has been held unchanged at -$12.5m to -$7.5m in all three releases of 2026 (Q4'25, Q1'26, Q2'26), so the line has never surprised. Q1's EBITDA beat its guide (-$5.8m vs -$7.25m to -$6.75m) and the stock still fell 16.6%.
evidence.why_not_priced: Previews quote 'Q4 adj. EBITDA > $0' as a target but do not do the YTD walk showing that the FY guide's low end is already breached at the Q3 midpoint. If the market had priced the risk of a slip, a reaffirmed Q4 target would be a relief trade and the run-up would have stalled into the print. Neither has happened. This is arithmetic on company numbers, not a forecast of a miss: Q1 beat its EBITDA guide by about $1.2m, which is why the size is small.
evidence.independence: The Q1 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1603015/000160301526000013/viaq126pressrelease.htm) carries Q1 EBITDA. The Earnings Whispers preview of 2026-11-02 (https://finviz.com/news/413691/vias-75-rally-sets-a-high-bar-as-school-launches-and-pipeline-face-their-test) separately notes that some margin pullback is expected and that a sharp margin reversal would challenge the thesis.
